description: This file defines the LiveActivityManager class responsible for managing live activity lifecycle, including starting, updating, and ending activities, with focus on connection health and cleanup.

classes.name: LiveActivityManager
classes.description: Singleton class managing live activity lifecycle, including starting, reconnecting, disconnecting, and cleanup of stale activities.

methods.name: startActivity
methods.description: Initiates a new live activity with specified agent name and session key, handling authorization and logging.

methods.name: handleConnecting
methods.description: Updates the activity state to connecting.

methods.name: handleReconnect
methods.description: Updates the activity state to idle.

methods.name: handleDisconnect
methods.description: Updates the activity state to disconnected.

methods.name: hydrateCurrentAndPruneDuplicates
methods.description: Ensures only the most recent activity remains active, ending older duplicates.

methods.name: connectingState
methods.description: Returns the activity content state indicating connecting status.

methods.name: idleState
methods.description: Returns the activity content state indicating idle status.

methods.name: disconnectedState
methods.description: Returns the activity content state indicating disconnected status.
